nodes.description: mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) public rewards; per-user per-collection accrued reward balance
mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) public lastUpdate; last timestamp rewards were settled for a user/collection
mapping(uint256 => CollectionInfo) public collectionInfo; per-collection name/boostCap/hardCap
mapping(uint256 => uint256) public totalSupplyByCollection; cumulative minted supply per collection
mapping(uint256 => uint256) public remainingBoostByCollection; remaining boost budget per collection
mapping(uint256 => uint256) public remainingSupplyByCollection; remaining mintable supply per collection
ISpaceCows public spaceCows; external NFT contract queried for minting rates
initialize(string,string) public initializer; sets ERC20 metadata and mints 6,182,917.50 SM to msg.sender
updateUserTimeOnMint(address,uint256) external isAllowAddress; writes block.timestamp into lastUpdate
updateUserTime(address,uint256) internal; writes block.timestamp into lastUpdate
calculateRewards(uint256,uint256) internal view; computes boosted reward and consumed boost, clamps to remaining supply
setRewards(address,uint256) internal; accrues rewards, updates totalSupply/remainingSupply/remainingBoost and lastUpdate
updateReward(address,address,uint256) external isAllowAddress; settles rewards for _from and _to on transfer
getReward(address,uint256) external isAllowAddress; zeroes reward then _mint and emits RewardPaid
burn(address,uint256,uint256) external isAllowAddress; _burn of arbitrary _from without allowance, emits BurnedTokens
getTotalClaimable(address,uint256) external view; computes pending rewards using block.timestamp and minting rate
setSpaceCowsAddress(address) external onlyOwner; sets the ISpaceCows contract pointer
setCollectionInfo(...) external onlyOwner; initializes collection caps and remaining boost/supply
_authorizeUpgrade(address) internal onlyOwner override; empty body guarding UUPS upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall
msg.sender; used by isAllowAddress and onlyOwner access checks
block.timestamp; drives reward accrual and user timers
_mint(_to, reward) in getReward; mints fresh tokens from user-controlled reward accounting
spaceCows.getMintingRate(_user) external call executed inside setRewards before state updates
_burn(_from, _amount) destroys tokens of an arbitrary address with no allowance/ownership verification
remainingSupplyByCollection[_collection] -= finalReward; unchecked-style supply accounting subtraction
_name string parameter of initialize
_symbol string parameter of initialize
_user address parameter of updateUserTimeOnMint
_collection uint256 parameter of updateUserTimeOnMint
_mintingAmount uint256 parameter of calculateRewards
_collection uint256 parameter of calculateRewards
_user address parameter of setRewards
_collection uint256 parameter of setRewards
_from address parameter of updateReward
_to address parameter of updateReward
_collection uint256 parameter of updateReward
_to address parameter of getReward; receiver of minted rewards
_collection uint256 parameter of getReward
_from address parameter of burn; arbitrary address whose tokens are destroyed
_collection uint256 parameter of burn
_amount uint256 parameter of burn
_user address parameter of getTotalClaimable
_collection uint256 parameter of getTotalClaimable
_nftContract address parameter of setSpaceCowsAddress
_collectionIndex uint256 parameter of setCollectionInfo
_collectionName string parameter of setCollectionInfo
_boostCap uint256 parameter of setCollectionInfo
_hardCap uint256 parameter of setCollectionInfo
newImplementation address parameter of _authorizeUpgrade
local uint256 time = block.timestamp in updateUserTime/updateUserTimeOnMint
local uint256 boostRewards in calculateRewards
local uint256 finalMintingReward in calculateRewards
local uint256 removedBoost in calculateRewards
local uint256 remainingBoost = remainingBoostByCollection[_collection] in calculateRewards
local uint256 remainingSupply = remainingSupplyByCollection[_collection] in calculateRewards
local uint256 userTimer = lastUpdate[_user][_collection] in setRewards
local uint256 mintingRate from spaceCows.getMintingRate(_user) in setRewards
local uint256 mintingReward = mintingRate * (time - userTimer) / 86400 in setRewards
local uint256 finalReward returned by calculateRewards in setRewards
local uint256 boostSupply returned by calculateRewards in setRewards
local uint256 reward = rewards[_to][_collection] in getReward
local uint256 pendingRewards computed in getTotalClaimable

edges.reason: isAllowAddress modifier requires msg.sender == spaceCows before updateUserTimeOnMint executes
isAllowAddress modifier gates updateReward on msg.sender being the spaceCows contract

isAllowAddress modifier gates burn, which destroys arbitrary balances, on msg.sender

onlyOwner restricts setCollectionInfo using msg.sender
onlyOwner restricts _authorizeUpgrade using msg.sender
initialize has the initializer modifier and mints the entire initial supply to msg.sender

block.timestamp drives pending reward computation in getTotalClaimable
